questions.answer: I applied for the courses I wanted to attend, and then I got a reply that I was accepted for some of them and not for others. Then I had to write to new course leaders to ask to be accepted in other courses.

questions.answer: Successful for some of them, and with others I had to choose alternatives.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Do everything as soon as possible
